WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
), city_shares AS (
    SELECT city, attendee_count,
           1.0 * attendee_count / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT attendee_count, share,
           share - AVG(share) OVER () AS amount_above_average
    FROM city_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM city_shares)
)
SELECT AVG(attendee_count) AS average_attendees,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(amount_above_average) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;
